notablePrerequisites: Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it.
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah's Shield.

uses.name: Pariah's Shield
uses.cardState: attached to any creature you control
